nf63ab14c88.headline: Oil extends steepest weekly decline since 2020 as traders assess Iran…
nf63ab14c88.summary: Oil prices fell further on Monday after their biggest weekly drop since April 2020, as traders weighed prospects for a deal involving Iran.
nf63ab14c88.why: Brent crude is the main global oil benchmark, and its price feeds into inflation, energy company earnings and transport costs worldwide.
nf63ab14c88.why_moved: Oil fell for a fifth consecutive session after the biggest weekly drop since 2020, as traders assessed the Iran outlook.

n3267c33750.headline: Tech set to still sway US stock market’s course despite AI-driven swoon
n3267c33750.summary: Despite a steep pullback in AI-related names, the US stock market is expected to depend on technology shares, with investors watching for risks to the trade.
n3267c33750.why: The S&P 500 is a benchmark index for large US companies, and technology stocks carry heavy weight in it.

n4b8846c2de.headline: High Court affirms NSW court’s denial of Uber’s payroll tax appeal
n4b8846c2de.summary: The High Court of Australia affirmed a New South Wales court's denial of Uber's payroll tax appeal, finding the rideshare company liable for tax on fares remitted to drivers.
n4b8846c2de.why: Uber is a global ride-hailing platform whose driver classification and tax treatment affect its operating costs in several markets.

n789ba36cc0.headline: ANZ's cost-cutting delivers bumper profit growth
n789ba36cc0.summary: ANZ's cash profit rose to $7.6 billion after the bank cut thousands of staff, with the strong result attributed in part to its cost reductions.
n789ba36cc0.why: ANZ is one of Australia's four major banks, so its profit trends are closely watched as a gauge of the country's banking sector.

n2852d41994.headline: CNH Industrial N.V. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
n2852d41994.summary: CNH Industrial reported third-quarter 2026 consolidated revenues of $4.4 billion, roughly flat year on year, with net income of $35 million.
n2852d41994.why: CNH Industrial makes agricultural and construction equipment, so its results reflect demand in farming and infrastructure markets.

n253997156b.headline: THEON Announces Q3 2026 / 9M 2026 Trading Update Reconfirms Previously Upgraded FY 2026 Guidance and Revises Upwards Medium-Term Guidance
n253997156b.summary: Theon International reconfirmed its upgraded FY 2026 guidance in its Q3 and nine-month trading update and revised its medium-term guidance upwards.
n253997156b.why: Theon International is a Cyprus-incorporated media and technology company listed in Amsterdam, and its guidance signals its expected financial trajectory.

n43e32ad19e.headline: Sri Lanka Workers in Demand as Thailand Turns to Island Nation to Fill Critical Labour Gaps
n43e32ad19e.summary: Thailand is turning to Sri Lanka to fill critical labour gaps as it faces a growing manpower shortfall.
n43e32ad19e.why: Migrant labour flows affect sectors such as manufacturing, agriculture and construction in receiving economies like Thailand.

nd5068b89ca.headline: Cyprus real estate conundrum: stats say affordable, reality says no
nd5068b89ca.summary: Cyprus's house price-to-income ratio remained below its long-term average in 2025, according to Eurostat figures, though housing affordability concerns persist.
nd5068b89ca.why: Eurostat publishes EU housing affordability statistics that guide policy and property market analysis across member states.

n3c5806b559.headline: Oil prices fall as Trump signals no immediate strikes on Iran
n3c5806b559.summary: Oil prices declined on Monday, 9 November, after US President Donald Trump's comments suggested a lower probability of further military action against Iran, according to Reuters.
n3c5806b559.why: Brent is the main global crude benchmark, and oil prices feed into inflation, transport costs and energy-company earnings. Tensions involving Iran, a major producer, are a recurring driver of crude prices.
n3c5806b559.why_moved: Comments from the US president suggested a reduced likelihood of further military action against Iran, which lowers the risk premium priced into oil.

nd4a6207933.headline: Nifty slips to 24,882 at midday; IT, Steel, Cement drag as Rupee hits 2026 high
nd4a6207933.summary: The Sensex fell 362.13 points, or 0.45%, to 80,637.27 and the Nifty slipped to 24,882 at midday, as selling spread across IT, metals and cement. The rupee hit a 2026 high.
nd4a6207933.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the benchmark indexes of Indian equities listed on the BSE and NSE. The rupee's strength affects importers, exporters and foreign investor returns.
nd4a6207933.why_moved: Selling pressure broadened across IT, metals and cement, overwhelming early gains in banking and pharma stocks.

n5058107f6f.headline: Remsons net up 25% in Q2 on better product mix
n5058107f6f.summary: Remsons Industries reported a 25% rise in Q2 net profit on a richer product mix. Revenue grew 17% to ₹135 crore, despite a decline in EBITDA.
n5058107f6f.why: Remsons Industries is an Indian manufacturer, and quarterly results indicate its profitability and margin trends for shareholders.

n1e5ec44740.headline: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia Launch Major Investment Fund to Strengthen Bilateral Trade and Economic Ties
n1e5ec44740.summary: Investors from Pakistan and Saudi Arabia launched a new private equity fund aimed at strengthening bilateral trade and economic ties, according to Pakistan Times.
n1e5ec44740.why: Private equity funds pool capital to invest in companies, and cross-border funds like this one channel Gulf capital into emerging markets.

n4433c7d5dd.headline: China-Backed Port City Colombo Takes Shape as Sri Lanka
n4433c7d5dd.summary: The China-backed Port City Colombo development is taking shape on land reclaimed from the sea on the outskirts of Colombo, according to Lanka Newspapers.
n4433c7d5dd.why: Port City Colombo is a large reclaimed-land development financed by Chinese investment, and it is a major foreign-investment project in Sri Lanka.

nd1fe78169e.headline: Portugal fuel prices drop 9 cents, biggest fall since March
nd1fe78169e.summary: Petrol and diesel prices in Portugal fell by 9 to 9.5 cents, the largest drop since March. The government's cut to the ISP tax discount may limit the decline.
nd1fe78169e.why: Fuel prices reflect crude costs, taxes and refining margins, and they feed into consumer inflation and transport costs in Portugal.

nb47930a5c0.headline: Nvidia shares drop after CEO Huang’s affair triggers board probe
nb47930a5c0.summary: Nvidia stock slid after its board opened a probe into chief executive Jensen Huang, who acknowledged having an affair. Reports said China may have spied on him.
nb47930a5c0.why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI chips, so leadership and governance issues at the company can affect investor confidence in the AI sector.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: The input reports the shares dropped after the board probe was announced.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nb47930a5c0.why_moved: The board's probe into the CEO's personal conduct and reports of possible foreign espionage raise leadership risk at a key AI chip supplier. The input notes the stock had already declined amid AI sustainability concerns.

n1589f28c06.headline: Indian rupee breaks six-day winning streak on state banks' dollar bids
n1589f28c06.summary: The rupee ended a six-session rally as state banks' dollar bids offset gains. Traders are watching Reserve Bank of India considerations and global cues.
n1589f28c06.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and returns for foreign portfolio investors in Indian assets.

impacts.name: Indian rupee
impacts.why: The rupee ended its six-session winning streak, per the input.

ndf245b2373.headline: DGTR recommends anti-dumping duty on rubber glove imports from Thailand, Malaysia
ndf245b2373.summary: India's trade remedy body DGTR recommended a proposed five-year anti-dumping duty on rubber glove imports from Thailand and Malaysia. The final decision rests with the Finance Ministry.
ndf245b2373.why: Anti-dumping duties protect domestic manufacturers from low-priced imports and affect trade flows between India and its Asian suppliers.

nf4f277c700.headline: NBI Files ₱13-B Economic Sabotage Charges Against 13 in Agricultural Smuggling Case
nf4f277c700.summary: The National Bureau of Investigation filed ₱13 billion in economic sabotage charges against 13 individuals in a large agricultural smuggling syndicate. Authorities described the case as a step in protecting national economic security.
nf4f277c700.why: Smuggling of agricultural goods distorts local food markets and tax revenue, which matters for food-sector investors and policymakers.

nbc8e6289fc.headline: 26 KP public universities face Rs5.6 billion deficits, seek Rs18 billion federal bailout
nbc8e6289fc.summary: At least 26 of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's 34 public-sector universities face a growing financial crisis, with a cumulative deficit of Rs5.6 billion. They are seeking an Rs18 billion federal bailout.
nbc8e6289fc.why: Provincial public universities depend on government funding, and fiscal strain in the sector reflects pressure on Pakistan's public finances.

n8e411be8c0.headline: (Update) Japan Bought Record 7.9 T. Yen in Forex Intervention July 30
n8e411be8c0.summary: Japan's record forex intervention on July 30 totalled 7.9 trillion yen, according to an updated report. The source gives no further detail on the operation.
n8e411be8c0.why: Japan's Ministry of Finance intervenes in currency markets to counter sharp yen moves, and large interventions affect yen-denominated assets and Japanese trade flows.
n8e411be8c0.why_moved: Japan's authorities bought yen in a record amount, a direct intervention that tends to support the currency.

n0a074328cb.headline: Kakao Mobility, Nvidia Aim to Develop Level 4 System That Meets Global Standards
n0a074328cb.summary: Kakao Mobility and Nvidia signed a memorandum to develop a Level 4 autonomous driving system meeting global standards. The plan pairs Kakao Mobility's driving AI with Nvidia's computing platform and its Halos safety system.
n0a074328cb.why: Kakao Mobility is a unit of South Korea's Kakao, a major mobility and platform operator, and Nvidia supplies the AI computing hardware used in autonomous driving.

nc87844e43e.headline: Finolex Cables Posts 68% Profit Growth as Shares Retreat After Muhurat
nc87844e43e.summary: Finolex Cables reported a 68% rise in profit, with consolidated revenue up 64.9% year on year to ₹2,269.33 crore for the quarter ended September 30. Shares retreated after the Muhurat trading session.
nc87844e43e.why: Finolex Cables is an Indian manufacturer of electrical cables and wires, a sector tied to construction and infrastructure spending.

nb3d0ed0be5.headline: Mitsui Chemicals Announces Deal to Acquire JSR
nb3d0ed0be5.summary: Mitsui Chemicals announced a deal to acquire JSR, a Japanese materials company. The source provides no further terms.
nb3d0ed0be5.why: Mitsui Chemicals is a major Japanese chemicals maker, and acquisitions in specialty materials can reshape competition in electronics and industrial materials.

n7ef7defb17.headline: India-EU review FTA progress ahead of PM Modi's Brussels visit, push investment and trade ties
n7ef7defb17.summary: India and the EU reviewed engagements to boost trade and investment, including timely signing and implementation of the India-EU free trade agreement. The review comes ahead of Prime Minister Modi's Brussels visit.
n7ef7defb17.why: A free trade agreement between India and the European Union would reduce tariffs and shape bilateral trade and investment flows between two large economies.

nd03018e262.headline: Why Micron Stock Fell 17% Last Month
nd03018e262.summary: Micron stock fell 17% last month as investors began panicking about the AI trade in October. The source attributes the decline to sentiment around the AI trade.
nd03018e262.why: Micron is a major maker of memory chips, including DRAM and HBM used in AI servers, so its share price is closely tied to AI hardware demand.

n1922531c0f.headline: Petrol Cars in Pakistan Could Become Up to Rs1 Million Cheaper Under New Auto Policy
n1922531c0f.summary: Car buyers in Pakistan could receive substantial relief under a proposed new automobile policy, with prices of locally made petrol vehicles expected to fall. The policy is still at the proposal stage.
n1922531c0f.why: Pakistan's auto sector is shaped by government tariffs and industrial policy, which determine vehicle prices and the competitiveness of local car makers.

n3c3bf0b294.headline: Pakistan Railways Reports Record Rs 115 Billion Revenue, Targets Rs 160 Billion
n3c3bf0b294.summary: Pakistan Railways recorded revenue of Rs115 billion for the first time, a milestone announced by Federal Minister for Railways Hanif. The target is Rs160 billion.
n3c3bf0b294.why: Pakistan Railways is a state-owned operator, and its revenue and finances bear on the government's fiscal position and transport policy.
